plugins.description: MyRoomSearch, by Londoner in Sydney, finds the lowest real price for a hotel stay. It compares Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, Trivago and the hotel's own site in your Chrome, and shows the results in a live web-app tab.
